behavior: A job shows a dated record of the quote, its acceptance, each invoice, each step done with its delivery link, and each payment, on the job page and the quote page
acceptance: The owner's and the public job reads give each payment's invoicedAt (when its invoice was made) and paidAt (the block time of the payment that completed it, null until paid).

The job page and the quote page show a Record panel listing, oldest first: quote made, accepted (the owner also sees the email), each invoice made, each step marked done with its delivery link, each invoice paid; times come from the server.

Tests: a Go test for invoicedAt and paidAt; a web unit test for the record's events and order; the e2e sees the record on a real job and on the mocked quote page; axe finds no serious or critical violations.
openapi.yaml, api.md and DESIGN.md describe the fields and the panel.
